questions.statement: Analyze the following statements according to the article: I. Essen was heavily affected by pollution, experiencing significant environmental degradation for the last century and a half. II. In the Zollverein complex, old buildings have been remodeled into modern, sustainable and environmentally-friendly industries. III. Although a cycling highway is under development and places to go hiking and be in touch with nature are now available, there are still challenges for people to access them. IV. Once deemed biologically lifeless, fish and other animal species can only be seen in the River Emscher again due to its restoration, which took twenty years. V. People have not been able to go in the Lake Baldeney since 2017, but this is about to change because of Essen’s green-and-blue approach. The statements which bring only completely accurate information are:

options.text: I and V only.
I and IV only.
II and V only.
II, III and V only.
I, III and IV only.

questions.explanation: O texto confirma a poluição histórica de Essen e a recuperação do rio Emscher após duas décadas. Zollverein virou complexo cultural e parque, não indústria moderna; as trilhas são acessíveis por transporte público e o lago voltou a permitir banhos em 2017.

questions.statement: The Hodgsoniana blog’s owner mentions the 150th anniversary alongside Hodgson's obscurity. What does this imply?

options.text: He is suggesting that, after more than a century, Hodgson’s life and work haven’t received the attention they deserve.
He argues that, despite the passage of time, Hodgson’s life and work have finally caught scholars’ attention.
He is implying a contradiction between historical obscurity and canonical recognition by scholars like Sam Gafford.
He is celebrating Hodgson’s newfound recognition online, despite being ignored by scholars.
He is arguing that, despite being very popular during his lifetime, Hodgson fell into obscurity.

questions.explanation: A menção aos 150 anos de nascimento, contrastada com a obscuridade de Hodgson, sugere reconhecimento ainda insuficiente de sua trajetória e obra. O texto não sustenta notoriedade acadêmica recente, consagração canônica nem fama comprovada em vida.

In the context of the comic strip, Text VI, it is possible to infer that the human:

options.text: will honestly try to understand women, even though it will be difficult.
will genuinely try to comprise women by asking questions and engaging in real conversations.
will act as if he understands, even when he does not.
will intend to fully grasp emotions but will lack the ability to express them.
will change his attitude after realizing new information.

questions.explanation: A inferência é que o personagem fingirá compreender o que não compreende, como sugere a fala 'I'll pretend I do'. Isso difere de buscar entendimento sincero por meio de perguntas, expressar emoções com dificuldade ou transformar efetivamente a própria atitude.

questions.statement: Do statements agree with the information from the Text 2? Decide True (T) if the statement agrees with the information from the article or False (F) if the statement contradicts the information from the article. ( ) The study has shown that although people who read tend to be more intelligent, they have more difficulties with social interactions. ( ) The study with 124 participants researched their own reading preferences as well as how they notice what is happening to other people. ( ) People who prefer watching TV tend to be more polite and better behaved. ( ) Literature as a whole affects people equally, regardless of the genre. ( ) The study does not decisively prove that reading actually makes people become nicer. Now choose the alternative with the correct sequence.

options.text: T – F – T – F – T.
T – T – F – T – F.
F – T – F – T – F.
F – T – F – F – T.
F – F – T – F – T.

questions.explanation: A sequência é falso, verdadeiro, falso, falso e verdadeiro. O texto refuta a suposta dificuldade social dos leitores, descreve a avaliação de empatia, associa a TV a menor compreensão, diferencia gêneros e não demonstra causalidade.
